extension.summary: Skip recap, Skip intro and Next episode buttons for video add-ons
extension.description: A shared module for video add-ons: shows Skip recap and Skip intro buttons over the video while those parts play, and at the credits a Next episode countdown with Watch credits. The add-on supplies the times (for example from its service's metadata). Used by the Starz add-on.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - First release: Skip recap, Skip intro, Next episode countdown and Watch credits
